messages.text: Wednesday, September 23 · Canton, Michigan
Light drizzle, a cosmic lecture, and a feline birthday

A day of light drizzle and cooler temperatures settles in. Consider an AI and creativity lecture in Ann Arbor or a music residency in Ypsilanti, as the local thread focuses on city council spending plans.
Expect light drizzle today with a high near 64°F and a low around 51°F.
Sunrise is at 7:22 AM, sunset at 7:29 PM, with the moon waxing gibbous and 87.5% illuminated.
Nearby events to consider
Attend Etgar Keret's free lecture "Me, Myself, and AI" at Rackham Amphitheatre at 5 PM, or experience the Telegraph Quartet's relaxed string quartet performance at the Ypsi Freighthouse at 6 PM.
Tomorrow marks Evil Gigawatt's birthday.
Ann Arbor's plans for downtown property sale funds

Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for millions expected from the sale of the city-owned Kline’s lot. The funds will be allocated to 12 different projects, including affordable housing and sustainable energy initiatives.
Looking ahead to tomorrow and beyond
Tomorrow, catch a performance by the Nate Topo Group at Blue LLaMA Jazz Club or pianist Barron Ryan at Kerrytown Concert House. This Saturday, the full moon is expected.
Autonomous navigation and lunar landing tests

NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and star catalogs. Additionally, NASA has begun its most flight-relevant lunar landing plume tests, measuring crater formation and ejecta in a vacuum sphere.
The next Starship launch is estimated no earlier than September 18, 2026, according to independent estimates.
A quiet moment can hold the most discovery.
Thursday, September 24 · Canton, Michigan
Autumn's clear sky meets a jazz evening
A mostly clear and mild autumn day offers a chance to enjoy local music or explore technological advancements. The day also marks a birthday for a familiar local figure.
Expect a mostly clear day with a high near 70°F and a low around 51°F, with no chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:24 AM, sunset at 7:27 PM, with the moon a waxing gibbous at 93.4% illumination.
Nearby happenings for Thursday

In Ann Arbor, catch jazz guitarists Dan Denison and Austin Netherton at El Limon at 6 PM, or pianist Barron Ryan at Kerrytown Concert House at 7:30 PM. For theater, consider "Bastard" at the Purple Rose Theatre Company in Chelsea at 7:30 PM.
Evil Gigawatt's birthday is today.
Ann Arbor's plans for downtown sale proceeds
Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for the expected $14.2 million to $17.4 million from the sale of the city-owned Kline’s lot. The funds will be allocated to 12 different projects.
Looking ahead to Friday and the weekend
Tomorrow, consider the free outdoor screening of "Best in Show" at Campus Martius Park in Detroit at 7 PM, or Dolly Day at the Ann Arbor District Library at 5:30 PM. Saturday brings the full moon.
Space navigation without GPS

NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and star catalogs. The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has cleared its flight-readiness review, targeting a launch later this month.
The schedule for Starship Flight 14 is not officially set by SpaceX, with independent estimates listing no earlier than September 18, 2026.
A clear sky often invites a thoughtful pause.
